title: 综合实验：阿司匹林合成
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/177_综合实验：阿司匹林合成.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/177_综合实验：阿司匹林合成/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一瓶白色晶体站在通风柜旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fume hood holding up a small vial of white crystals, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第十五课：综合实验，阿司匹林合成。
overlay: 综合实验：阿司匹林合成

shots.scene: 阿杰在敞开台面上拧开乙酸酐，眼睛流泪
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens a reagent bottle on an open bench, sharp vapor rising, his eyes watering, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰在台面上打开乙酸酐，熏得流泪。

shots.scene: 他想尝一口做出的晶体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand bringing a spatula of white crystals toward a mouth, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 还想尝尝自己做的阿司匹林。

shots.scene: 小研：每一步都有安全要点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing safety goggles stops him and points to a fume hood with its sash lowered.
shots.narration: 小研：合成每一步，都有安全要点。

shots.scene: 合成路线造出药物和材料
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small building block molecules joining into a medicine capsule, a plastic material and a protein icon. No text.
shots.narration: 合成能造出药物、材料和生物分子。

shots.scene: 阿司匹林：退热、止痛、抗炎
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a medicine tablet with three icons for fever, pain and swelling relief. No text.
shots.narration: 阿司匹林能退热、止痛、抗炎。

shots.scene: 这是最简单的一步合成
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a short path with one step leading to a vial, a long road with many steps beyond it. No text.
shots.narration: 这是最简单的合成，后面路还长。

shots.scene: 化学名乙酰水杨酸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a simple molecular structure sketch of acetylsalicylic acid with the acetyl part highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 阿司匹林的化学名叫乙酰水杨酸。

shots.scene: 水杨酸+乙酸酐，浓硫酸催化
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a salicylic acid molecule plus an acetic anhydride molecule, a small catalyst drop above the arrow, giving the product. No text.
shots.narration: 水杨酸和乙酸酐反应，浓硫酸催化。

shots.scene: 酚羟基接上一个乙酰基
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the hydroxyl group on the ring replaced by an acetyl group, a highlight circle on the change. No text.
shots.narration: 水杨酸的酚羟基接上了乙酰基。

shots.scene: 流程三步：反应、提纯、检验
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three boxes in a row, a flask, a filter funnel and a test tube, connected by arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 流程三步：反应、提纯、检验。

shots.scene: 每一步用前面学过的技能
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a balance, a vacuum filter, a recrystallization flask and a melting point apparatus linked into one chain. No text.
shots.narration: 每一步都用到前面学过的基本操作。

shots.scene: 乙酸酐：腐蚀、催泪、易燃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reagent bottle with corrosive and flammable pictograms, a teary eye icon and a flame icon. No text.
shots.narration: 乙酸酐腐蚀刺激、催泪，还易燃。

shots.scene: 乙酸酐遇水反应放热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a water drop meeting the reagent with heat waves and a fizz, a caution icon. No text.
shots.narration: 乙酸酐遇水会反应放热。

shots.scene: 浓硫酸强腐蚀，沾上就灼伤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle of concentrated acid with a corrosive pictogram dripping onto a hand icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 浓硫酸强腐蚀，沾上就会灼伤。

shots.scene: 原片说乙酸乙酯，实为乙酸酐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two similar bottles, one marked with a wrong label icon crossed out and the correct reagent checked. No text.
shots.narration: 原片误说乙酸乙酯，危险的是乙酸酐。

shots.scene: 读标签和SDS，穿戴齐全
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat, safety goggles and chemical resistant gloves reads a safety data sheet beside two reagent bottles.
shots.narration: 用前读标签和说明书，防护穿戴齐全。

shots.scene: 两种都属易制毒，领用登记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a locked chemical cabinet, a sign-out log and a small measured portion, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 两者都是易制毒品，按量领用登记。

shots.scene: 确认通风柜运行正常
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume hood airflow indicator showing normal and the sash at the marked working height. No text.
shots.narration: 用前确认通风柜运行正常。

shots.scene: 柜内加入乙酸酐
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adds a reagent from a small graduated cylinder into a conical flask inside a fume hood, sash lowered, head outside.
shots.narration: 在通风柜里，往锥形瓶加乙酸酐。

shots.scene: 滴加少量浓硫酸作催化剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dropper adding a few drops of acid into the flask inside the fume hood, the bottle mouth pointing away from people. No text.
shots.narration: 再滴加少量浓硫酸，量按讲义。

shots.scene: 轻轻摇匀，瓶口不对人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask swirled gently with its mouth pointing toward the back of the fume hood, a face in front of the mouth crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 轻轻摇匀，瓶口不对着人。

shots.scene: 用完立即盖紧放回
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the reagent bottles capped tightly and returned to a ventilated cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 用完立即盖紧，放回原处。

shots.scene: 称水杨酸，放进锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: white powder weighed on a balance and transferred into a dry conical flask. No text.
shots.narration: 称取水杨酸，放进干燥的锥形瓶。

shots.scene: 准确质量记进数据表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a notebook data table with an entry being written beside the balance. No text.
shots.narration: 准确质量马上记进数据表。

shots.scene: 电热板上备好热水浴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beaker of water warming on an electric hot plate, an open flame burner crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 先在电热板上备好热水浴，不用明火。

shots.scene: 夹住烧瓶浸在热水里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the conical flask clamped on a stand and dipped into the warm water bath, even heat waves around it. No text.
shots.narration: 铁架台夹住烧瓶，浸在热水里。

shots.scene: 水浴比直接加热更均匀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: even heating around a flask in a water bath versus a hot spot under a flask placed directly on the plate, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 水浴比直接放电热板更均匀。

shots.scene: 温度时间按讲义控制
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thermometer icon and a timer icon beside the water bath with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 温度和时间按讲义控制。

shots.scene: 热烧杯用夹子拿，关了也烫
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tongs lifting a hot beaker, a switched off hot plate still glowing with heat waves, a bare hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 热烧杯用夹子拿，关了的电热板还烫。

shots.scene: 取出冷却到室温，晶体析出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the flask cooling on the bench, white crystals beginning to appear in the liquid. No text.
shots.narration: 取出冷却到室温，晶体就会析出。

shots.scene: 【实拍】玻璃棒轻刮内壁诱导
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a glass rod gently scratching the inside wall of a conical flask containing clear liquid.
shots.narration: 不析晶？用玻璃棒轻刮内壁。

shots.scene: 柜内沿壁慢加冷水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cold water added slowly down the inner wall of the flask inside the fume hood, splashing crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 还不析晶，柜内沿壁慢慢加冷水。

shots.scene: 冰水浴让结晶完全
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the flask sitting in a beaker of ice water, more crystals forming. No text.
shots.narration: 再放冰水浴，让晶体析出完全。

shots.scene: 布氏漏斗减压抽滤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a funnel with filter paper on a thick walled filter flask clamped to a stand, a vacuum hose attached. No text.
shots.narration: 用布氏漏斗减压抽滤，收集晶体。

shots.scene: 抽滤瓶厚壁无裂纹、夹牢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier checking the thick walled flask for cracks, a clamp holding it firmly. No text.
shots.narration: 抽滤瓶要厚壁、无裂纹，还要夹牢。

shots.scene: 【实拍】冷水冲洗烧瓶，转移晶体
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a wash bottle of cold water rinsing remaining crystals from a conical flask into the funnel.
shots.narration: 冷水冲洗烧瓶，晶体全部转进漏斗。

shots.scene: 抽干后转移，滤纸残留少量冲下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the dry crystal cake moved to a container, leftover crystals on the paper rinsed down with a small squirt of liquid. No text.
shots.narration: 抽干后转移，滤纸上的残留也收回。

shots.scene: 结束先拔管再关泵
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the vacuum hose pulled off the flask first, then the pump switched off, a backflow arrow crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 结束先拔管、再关泵，防止倒吸。

shots.scene: 粗品还混着原料
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: white crystals with a few odd starting material particles mixed in, a magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: 粗品还混着少量原料，要重结晶。

shots.scene: 少量乙醇溶解，加热水再加热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a little ethanol added to the crude solid, then hot water, warmed on a hot plate, the ethanol bottle kept far from the plate. No text.
shots.narration: 少量乙醇溶解，加热水，电热板加热。

shots.scene: 边热边补溶剂至全溶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small portions of solvent added while warming until the solid fully dissolves into a clear solution. No text.
shots.narration: 边加热边补溶剂，直到全部溶解。

shots.scene: 离开热源慢慢析晶，再冰浴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the flask removed from the hot plate cooling slowly, crystals growing, then placed in ice water. No text.
shots.narration: 离开热源慢慢析晶，最后再冰浴。

shots.scene: 【实拍】先称表面皿和滤纸皮重
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a dry watch glass with a folded filter paper placed on a balance pan.
shots.narration: 抽滤前，先称表面皿和滤纸的皮重。

shots.scene: 用这张滤纸抽滤并抽干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the same filter paper used in the funnel, crystals collected and sucked dry. No text.
shots.narration: 就用这张滤纸抽滤，再抽干。

shots.scene: 表面皿上晾干或低温烘干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: crystals spread on the watch glass drying at room temperature, and a low temperature oven icon. No text.
shots.narration: 放表面皿上晾干，或低温烘干。

shots.scene: 总重减皮重得产物质量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a total weight minus the tare weight giving the product mass, a simple subtraction card. No text.
shots.narration: 总重减去皮重，就是产物质量。

shots.scene: 产率=实际产量÷理论产量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small pile of actual product compared with a dotted outline of the theoretical amount, a percentage pie. No text.
shots.narration: 产率等于实际产量除以理论产量。

shots.scene: 做出来的真是阿司匹林吗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up the vial of white crystals with a question mark above his head.
shots.narration: 做出来的，真是阿司匹林吗？

shots.scene: 熔点、薄层色谱、光谱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a melting point apparatus, a chromatography plate and a spectrum chart side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 可用熔点、薄层色谱、光谱来确认。

shots.scene: 三氯化铁遇酚羟基变紫
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a drop of pale yellow test solution meeting a phenol group and the solution turning violet. No text.
shots.narration: 三氯化铁遇到酚羟基，会变成紫色。

shots.scene: 水杨酸有酚羟基，阿司匹林没有
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: salicylic acid with a highlighted phenol group beside aspirin where that group is capped. No text.
shots.narration: 水杨酸有酚羟基，阿司匹林没有。

shots.scene: 产物变紫：没做成或没除净
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a product tube turning violet with a warning icon, a recrystallize again arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 产物变紫，说明没做成或原料没除净。

shots.scene: 【实拍】四支试管排好，加检测液
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: four unlabeled test tubes in a rack, a dropper adding a few drops of pale yellow liquid to each, safety goggles visible.
shots.narration: 四支试管：原料、粗品、纯品、纯水。

shots.scene: 原料变紫，纯水不变
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the starting material tube violet and the pure water tube unchanged, both checked as expected. No text.
shots.narration: 原料变紫、纯水不变，检验可靠。

shots.scene: 粗品微紫，纯品不变色
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the crude tube faint violet and the pure product tube unchanged, a success check on the pure tube. No text.
shots.narration: 粗品微紫有残留，纯品不变色就成功。

shots.scene: 自制的不是药，不尝不吃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vial of lab-made crystals with a mouth crossed out and a medicine box crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 自己做的阿司匹林不是药，不尝不吃。

shots.scene: 不带出实验室，按要求上交
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the labeled sample vial handed to a teacher's tray, a bag carrying it out of the door crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不带出实验室，贴签按要求上交。

shots.scene: 滤液废液分类收集
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: acidic filtrate poured into a labeled waste container, ethanol waste into another, a sink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 滤液和废液分类收集，不倒水槽。

shots.scene: 酸酐浓酸：通风柜、护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume hood, safety goggles and gloves with the two reagent bottles, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: 酸酐和浓酸：通风柜里取，防护戴齐。

shots.scene: 水浴加热、抽滤、重结晶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a water bath, a vacuum filter and a recrystallization flask in a chain. No text.
shots.narration: 水浴加热，抽滤洗涤，重结晶提纯。

shots.scene: 三氯化铁检验；产物不吃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four test tubes with one violet, and a mouth crossed out beside a sample vial. No text.
shots.narration: 三氯化铁验纯度，产物不吃不带走。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着接种环站在生物安全柜旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small inoculation loop beside a biological safety cabinet and a culture plate, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：无菌操作与细胞培养。
